18-BET. Unit 3 'Home, Sweet Home!' — uy kesimi rasmi.

Bu — kitobdagi ENG KO'P RAQAMLI bet: 8 ta xona harfi (A-H), 22 ta raqamlangan buyum va 19 ta yozilgan so'z. Shuning uchun rasm bo'laklab kesib kattalashtirildi va HAR BIR raqam alohida tekshirildi.

XONA HARFLARI (tasdiqlandi):
  A = kitchen (pastki qavat)
  B = dining-room (pastki qavat)
  C = living-room (pastki qavat — kitobda berilgan)
  D = main bedroom (birinchi qavat)
  E = bathroom (birinchi qavat)
  F = child's bedroom (birinchi qavat)
  G = study (chordoq — kitobda berilgan)
  H = garage (uydan tashqarida)

22 RAQAM (hammasi tasdiqlandi):
  Oshxona:  1 dishwasher, 2 cooker, 3 fridge, 4 cupboards, 5 sink
  Ovqat xonasi: 6 dining-table, 7 chairs, 8 mirror
  Mehmonxona: 9 sofa (kitobda berilgan), 10 table, 11 fireplace, 12 armchair
  Katta yotoqxona: 13 wardrobe, 14 double bed
  Hammom: 15 bath, 16 washbasin, 17 toilet
  Bolalar xonasi: 18 bedside cabinet, 19 single bed
  Kabinet: 20 desk, 21 chair, 22 bookcase

⚠ ENG QIYIN JOY — 2 va 3-RAQAM: oshxonada muzlatgich va plita yonma-yon turadi va ikkalasi ham oq. Kesib OLTI BARAVAR kattalashtirib tekshirdim:
  • 2-raqamdan chiquvchi chiziq O'NGGA, plitaning tugmachalari yoniga boradi → COOKER
  • 3-raqamdan chiquvchi chiziq ChAPGA, ochiq eshikli oq shkaf tagiga boradi → FRIDGE
  • 1-raqamdan chiquvchi chiziq pastga, likopcha javonlari ko'rinib turgan ochiq mashinaga boradi → DISHWASHER

⚠ TEKShIRUV NUQTASI: kitobning o'zi 'sofa 9' deb namuna bergan. Bizning ma'lumotimizda ham divan = 9. Demak raqamlash to'g'ri bog'langan.

19 TA YOZILGAN SO'Z (raqamsiz, rasmda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozilgan): roof, wall, floor, door, window, stairs, chimney, garden, lamp, curtains, carpet, rug, cushion, pillows, vase, picture, towel, shower, dressing-table. Hammasi skanerda topildi.

⚠ FARQNI ESLAB QOLING:
  carpet — butun polni qoplaydigan gilam (mehmonxonada)
  rug    — kichik gilamcha (yotoqxonada, karavot yonida)
  cushion — divan yostiqchasi
  pillows — karavotdagi yostiqlar (odatda ko'plikda)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and fill in the gaps with the correct letters. Where is each room?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va bo'shliqlarga to'g'ri harflarni qo'ying. Har bir xona qayerda joylashgan?
exercises.explanationUz:
UY QAVATLARI — ingliz tilida O'ZGACHA sanaladi!

  ground floor — BIRINCHI qavat (yerdagi qavat)
  first floor  — IKKINCHI qavat
  second floor — UCHINCHI qavat
  attic        — tom ostidagi xona (chordoq)

Ya'ni inglizcha 'first floor' — o'zbekcha IKKINCHI qavat!
Bu AQShda boshqacha: u yerda 'first floor' = birinchi qavat.
Darslik BRITAN inglizchasida, shuning uchun ground/first tizimi.

Joy predloglari:
  ON the ground floor — qavatda
  IN the attic        — chordoqda
  OUTSIDE the house   — uydan tashqarida

exercises.instructionEn: What is there in each room?
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir xonada nima bor? 'There is / There are' bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU UNITNING ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI — 'there is' va 'there are':

  There IS a sofa in the living-room.       (BITTA narsa)
  There ARE some chairs in the dining-room. (KO'P narsa)

Qoida:
  • Birlik ot  → There is + A/AN + ot
  • Ko'plik ot → There are + SOME + ot(-s)

'some' — 'bir nechta' ma'nosida. Aniq soni muhim bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi.

DIQQAT — a yoki an?
  a sofa, a table, a fridge   (undosh tovush bilan boshlansa)
  an armchair                 (unli tovush bilan boshlansa)

O'zbekchada 'mehmonxonada divan bor' deymiz — gap XONA bilan boshlanadi.
Inglizchada esa gap 'There is...' bilan BOSHLANADI, xona OXIRIDA keladi.
Bu tuzilma o'zbek tilida yo'q, shuning uchun ko'p mashq qilish kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Learn the other labelled parts of the house.
exercises.explanationUz:
Rasmda raqamsiz, lekin nomi yozilgan narsalar ham bor.
Ular mashqda so'ralmagan, lekin Unit 3 lug'atiga kiradi va
keyingi betlarda ishlatiladi.

UY QISMLARI: roof, wall, floor, door, window, stairs, chimney, garden
JIHOZLAR: lamp, curtains, carpet, rug, cushion, pillows, vase, picture,
          mirror, towel, shower, dressing-table

wordFormation.introUz: Uy jihozlarining ko'pchiligi QO'SHMA so'z — ikki so'zdan yasalgan.

groups.explanationUz: Xona nomi ko'pincha 'nima uchun ishlatilishi' + room shaklida. Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.
Jihoz nomlari ham qo'shma. Birinchi so'z QAYERDA yoki NIMA UCHUN ekanini aytadi.
Kundalik nutqda uzun so'zlar qisqaradi. Qisqasi ko'proq ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Unit 3 ning ASOSIY tuzilmasi — 'there is / there are'.

patterns.formula: There IS + a/an + BIRLIK ot + in the XONA.
patterns.exampleEn: There is a sofa in the living-room.
patterns.explanationUz:
BITTA narsa uchun. 'a/an' SHART.
O'zbekchada gap joy bilan boshlanadi, inglizchada esa 'There is' bilan.

patterns.formula: There ARE + some + KO'PLIK ot + in the XONA.
patterns.exampleEn: There are some chairs in the dining-room.
patterns.explanationUz:
KO'P narsa uchun. 'some' — aniq soni muhim bo'lmaganda.
Ot KO'PLIKDA: chairs, cupboards (chair emas).

patterns.formula: The XONA is ON the ground/first floor.
patterns.exampleEn: The kitchen is on the ground floor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qavat uchun ON predlogi.
DIQQAT: 'ground floor' = o'zbekcha 1-qavat, 'first floor' = 2-qavat!

patterns.formula: The XONA is IN the attic. / OUTSIDE the house.
patterns.exampleEn: The study is in the attic. The garage is outside the house.
patterns.exampleUz: Ish xonasi chordoqda. Garaj uydan tashqarida.
patterns.explanationUz: Chordoq uchun IN (ichkarida), garaj uchun OUTSIDE (tashqarida).
